question: Who is the author of the book ‘The 7 Sins of Being a Mother’?
solution:
The correct answer is __Tahira Kashyap Khurrana.__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 7 Sins of Being a Mother is a book by Tahira Kashyap Khurrana, an Indian writer, filmmaker, and wife of actor Ayushmann Khurrana.
 
• The book was published in October 2021 by Juggernaut Books.
 
• The book is a collection of essays in which Khurrana shares her experiences of motherhood, both the good and the bad.
 
• She writes about the joys of raising children, as well as the challenges and frustrations. She also talks about the guilt that many mothers feel, and how she has learned to overcome it.
 
• The book has been praised for its honesty and humor. Khurrana's writing is relatable and insightful, and she does not shy away from discussing the more difficult aspects of motherhood.
